author: /root/lean_proof
method: Independent source/consumption-boundary semantic inspection against the captured pre-change instructions, FEATURE invariants, current callers, and eight frozen concrete cases. No live model replay or downstream application execution claimed.

cases.reason: AGENTS Understand And Route first inspects relevant PR/context and infers ordinary local repair from a clear defect report. Fix Classify requires expected behavior/evidence and distinguishes reopened delivery. Global Boundaries denies PR-comment/merge authority from review alone. The route does not depend on wording or patch size.

AGENTS routes changed behavior to Shape. Shape Discover investigates saved state, defaults/overrides, permissions and consumers; preserves unrelated permissions and asks remaining consequential choices with concrete tradeoffs, with no one-question cap. Start The Goal reuses/creates a scoped explicitly requested Goal; Specify continues already-authorized Ship without another permission question.

AGENTS gives observed runtime symptoms precedence and diagnosis-only read-only scope. Operate brackets environment/version/time/context, follows runtime evidence before assigning cause, and stops diagnosis-only at findings. A code-defect route remains subject to the explicit no-change scope in AGENTS, so it cannot itself authorize edits.

Ship Enter accepts a ready specified feature with independent proof, claims status, and expressly proceeds without Goal tools or a matching Goal. It preserves no invented budgets/Goals and no unrelated Goal takeover, while still requiring independent proof, affected verification and final distinct review.

AGENTS routes architecture assessment directly to coding-architecture-deep-dive, whose read-only scope and findings-do-not-authorize-implementation remain byte-identical apart from removal of the shared rulebook read. Shape/Ship package/Goal procedures are not entered merely for analysis; evidence explicitly avoids package creation for logging. Authoritative external verification remains bounded in AGENTS.

Shared proof Fixed Acceptance assigns setup correction exclusively to the independent author using unchanged contracts, retaining scenarios/assertions/outcomes/test selection/target/fakes. It preserves failed inputs, exact diff/rationale/new hashes outside PROOF, requires affected and complete reruns and final reviewer examination; unavailable author pauses repair, and Ship cannot edit frozen acceptance.

Fix identifies delivered-contract violation and reopens through status, preserving feature proof/review. Shared proof Restore requires separate author, archived originals/failure, preserved scenarios/target/real-fake boundary, full captured rerun and review; candidate behavior is expressly not the oracle. Latest own official PASS and distinct final review govern completion.

AGENTS and status restrict priority selection to requested queue continuation and eligible ready entries, preserve foreign active claims, and require user-authorized stopped-owner handoff. Helper owns locked atomic mutation and rejects takeover/manual bypass. Available deploy access does not satisfy explicit external-effect authorization. Goal/tool and runtime limits remain independent of status success.

findings: AGENTS now contains initial lifecycle, coding domain/review/support and capability-based noncoding routing; exact skill announcements, scope inference and user interaction rules have a single global owner. Focused skills no longer require the redundant rulebook.

Shape owns default scoped Goals, thorough product discovery and independent proof handoff. Ship owns authorized execution, stopping/resumption, verification and distinct final review. Fix keeps standalone/reopened/active-regression distinctions; Operate retains actual-runtime consumer read-back.

The only shared coding references are proof, status and evidence. Each opens with an explicit reader/occasion. Proof has real distinct callers for authoring, executing and restoring; status for registration/claim/reopen; evidence for material verification and proof-author records. They retain cross-skill mechanics rather than replacing the removed general guide.

Acceptance isolation, genuine UI/API/process boundary, relevant state/permissions and loaded-resource read-back, separate acceptance/regression placement, no foreign whole-proof reuse, independent setup repair/restoration, fixed input hashes, newer failed/unfinished override and observed-broken precedence all remain explicit.

Status retains mandatory adopted-repository schema, exact field ownership, atomic helper use, safe original-index archival and locked migration, no invented owners/PASS, complete scaffold, latest local own official proof pointer, foreign/symlink/stale/regression rejection, one active owner/task, and no timeout takeover.

Material completion still requires named-target proof, affected regressions and fresh reviewer distinct from implementer/author, on stable relevant inputs. Standalone Fix remains lightweight and explicit analysis/review-only remains direct. No extra package/reviewer for regressions introduced within Ship.

Global external/destructive authorization, unrelated dirty work, existing instructions, no target AGENTS creation, domain/platform ownership, shared scripts and repository gate remain. Evidence retains official/regression command modes, incomplete attempts, private native dialogue, redaction, partial-capture honesty and precise limits of digest/capture protection.

README remains human orientation linking directly to current owners; no mandatory replacement policy layer was created. Existing specialized techniques changed only by removal of redundant shared-rulebook references relative to captured baseline. Scripts/inventory and earlier evidence are protected byte-for-byte by executable checks.
limitations: Source semantic assessment cannot establish future agent compliance or live application correctness.
Some implementation detail already exposed by script help and repeated prose was intentionally removed; script semantics are unchanged and protected.
